# Bazaar residents v1

Generated with the built-in `image_gen` tool on 2026-09-25.

`bazaar-residents-v1.png` retains the original transparent image. The companion JSON atlas selects the twelve individual figures without changing the source pixels. Frames are named for `CITY_NPCS` IDs; the bazaar scene preserves aspect ratio and uses heights of 70 px for adults, 62 px for the student, and 50 px for the child. Adba retains his existing dedicated artwork. These are stationary conversation sprites.

## Final prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production sprite atlas for a retro 16-bit top-down JRPG bazaar town. Create exactly 12 DIFFERENT full-body NPC sprites in an exact regular 4 columns by 3 rows grid on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Canvas 1024 x 1024. Each cell is 256 wide, 341 tall approximately. All sprites centered horizontally in their cells, aligned soles, lots of transparent space between sprites. Crisp chunky low-resolution pixel art, dark brown outlines, limited warm earthy colors, big readable heads compact bodies, slight overhead view, front-facing or slight three-quarter toward viewer. Each adult occupies about 140 wide x 220 high pixels within its cell, child 110 x 170. No cast shadows, scenery, labels, text, grid lines or cell borders. Order left to right top to bottom: 1 portly male cloth merchant with turban, burgundy vest, folded bolt of fabric; 2 young woman market helper with dark braid, cream apron, basket of vegetables; 3 elderly traveler with white beard, ochre cloak, walking staff; 4 short stocky repair woman with tied auburn hair, navy apron, wrench; 5 muscular dark skinned dock worker with short hair, sleeveless teal shirt, rope over shoulder; 6 slim male trade clerk with glasses, neatly parted hair, cream shirt and indigo waistcoat holding ledger; 7 woman traveler with curly hair, plum coat and travel satchel; 8 caravan driver with broad straw hat, olive poncho and boots; 9 young female student with bob haircut, turquoise tunic holding closed book; 10 elderly woman reader with gray bun, lavender dress reading an open book; 11 cheerful small child with short black hair, red shirt, blue shorts holding yellow pinwheel; 12 stout innkeeper with mustache, white shirt, orange apron holding tray with cup. Distinct ages builds silhouettes hairstyles and held items; cohesive sprite style. These are ordinary living town residents, not warriors. Pixel edges must be crisp; no smooth illustration or antialiasing.
